Operator.title: Operator
Operator.description: Represents a cleaning operator within the WorkForce Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Operator entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the cleaning operator.

lastName.description: The last name of the cleaning operator.

email.description: The email address of the cleaning operator.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the cleaning operator.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Represents an administrator within the WorkForce Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Admin entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the administrator.

lastName.description: The last name of the administrator.

email.description: The email address of the administrator.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the administrator.

Shift.title: Shift
Shift.description: Represents a work shift for a cleaning operator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Shift entity.

startTime.description: The date and time the shift started.

endTime.description: The date and time the shift ended.

LeaveRequest.title: LeaveRequest
LeaveRequest.description: Represents a leave request submitted by a cleaning operator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LeaveRequest entity.

startDate.description: The start date of the leave request.

endDate.description: The end date of the leave request.

reason.description: The reason for the leave request.

status.description: The status of the leave request (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).

adminId.description: Reference to Admin who approved or rejected the request. (Relationship: Admin 1:N LeaveRequest)

rejectionReason.description: The reason for rejecting the leave request (if applicable).

SupplyRequest.title: SupplyRequest
SupplyRequest.description: Represents a request for cleaning supplies submitted by a cleaning operator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SupplyRequest entity.

productName.description: The name of the requested cleaning product.

quantity.description: The quantity of the requested cleaning product.

requestDate.description: The date the supply request was submitted.

status.description: The status of the supply request (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).

adminId.description: Reference to Admin who approved or rejected the request. (Relationship: Admin 1:N SupplyRequest)

rejectionReason.description: The reason for rejecting the supply request (if applicable).

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure has been flattened to improve query performance and simplify security rules. Collections like shifts, leave-requests, and supply-requests are now at the top level. Each document within these collections contains a userId or operatorId to associate it with a specific user. This allows administrators to easily query all documents in a collection, while operators' access can be restricted to only documents containing their own ID. This resolves the permission errors caused by attempting collection group queries on a nested structure. The Announcement and Communication entities and collections have been removed as per the user's request.
